title: Daycount Year Fraction
description: Prices one caller-supplied date pair under one declared day-count mode and rolls both dates under the three ISDA 2006 Section 4.12 business-day conventions. Nine closed modes: the seven _amort day-count modes extracted byte-compatibly (ISDA 2006 Definitions Section 4.16 six calendar conventions plus the declared UNIT_PERIOD stub mode) and two new ids, ACT_ACT_ICMA (ICMA Rule 251 over a declared coupon-period schedule and frequency) and BUS_252 (business days over a caller calendar divided by 252). Every year fraction is an exact gcd-reduced integer rational {num, den} plus a single-division float convenience value; every out-of-domain input is a named structured refusal. Demonstrator for the shared _daycount.bundle.mjs kernel (SHARED-DAYCOUNT-BUNDLE-1).

mode.description: Day-count mode. The seven _amort ids are extracted byte-compatibly; ACT_ACT_ICMA and BUS_252 are new ids this bundle adds.

start.description: Accrual start date as YYYY-MM-DD (a real proleptic-Gregorian calendar date; nonexistent dates are refused).

end.description: Accrual end date as YYYY-MM-DD; an end before start is refused (REFUSED_DATE_ORDER), never silently negative.

is_termination.description: 30E_360_ISDA only: whether end is the Termination Date (its last-day-of-February cap does not apply to a Termination Date).

unit_fraction.description: UNIT_PERIOD only: the DECLARED stub fraction in (0, 1]; a whole period is exactly 1. Read at the declared 1e-9 half-up scale; out-of-range is refused.

frequency.description: ACT_ACT_ICMA only: compounding frequency per year, one of 1, 2, 4, 12 (default 2).

schedule.description: ACT_ACT_ICMA only: the caller-declared ordered regular coupon periods, each {start, end} as YYYY-MM-DD, at most 1200 periods. The date pair must lie within one declared period or the fraction is refused.

calendar.description: Business-day calendar, caller DATA hash-pinned via policy_parameters (the _ruleversion ruling) — none is baked into kernel bytes. Required for BUS_252 and for rolls; at most 5000 holidays.

weekend.description: Weekday numbers that are non-business days, 0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday (e.g. [0, 6]).

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_daycount_year_fraction
mcp_tool_definition.description: Day-count year fraction and business-day rolls for one date pair: exact rational {num, den} under one of nine closed modes (the seven ISDA 2006 Sec 4.16 / UNIT_PERIOD modes plus ACT_ACT_ICMA per ICMA Rule 251 and BUS_252), with following / modified following / preceding rolls over a caller-supplied holiday calendar. Structured refusals, never silent defaults.

fraction.description: Exact gcd-reduced integer rational {num, den}, den > 0; null on a refusal.

fraction_value.description: Declared single-division float convenience form num/den.

parts.description: ACT_ACT_ISDA only: the clause's own per-calendar-year summands ({num, den} per year, leap /366, non-leap /365).

business_days_between.description: BUS_252 only: the raw business-day count over the caller calendar (d1 exclusive, d2 inclusive).

rolls.description: Present when a calendar is supplied: following, modified_following, preceding per ISDA 2006 Sec 4.12, applied to both dates.

refusal.description: Named structured refusal code (REFUSED_UNKNOWN_CONVENTION, REFUSED_BAD_DATE, REFUSED_DATE_ORDER, REFUSED_SCHEDULE_REQUIRED, REFUSED_SCHEDULE_TOO_LONG, REFUSED_SCHEDULE_RANGE, REFUSED_BAD_FREQUENCY, REFUSED_NO_CALENDAR, REFUSED_BAD_UNIT_FRACTION, REFUSED_DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE, REFUSED_ROLL_UNBOUNDED), null on success.

caveats.description: AUTHORING-STANDARD Sec 2 flag-mirror: mirrors the conditional compliance_flags (named refusal codes), empty on a clean run.

source: authored by SHARED-DAYCOUNT-BUNDLE-1 per ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md Sec 0.1/4 and the plan item 3 in research/browser-first-primitives-revised-plan-2026-10-16.md. The seven _amort modes were extracted from chaingraph/kernels/_amort.bundle.mjs (ACCT-AMORT-K-1) and differentially tested against it over 23,216,200 ordered date pairs spanning 1990-2060 with every month end and every Feb 28/29: zero mismatches at the amortization bundle's declared 10-decimal half-up rounding (calendar modes agree to 1.4e-14 raw; the declared UNIT_PERIOD stub agrees within its declared 1e-9 scale); defects D2/D3/D5/D17 of research/browser-first-primitives-enhancements-2026-10-16.md are closed by design (no divisor tables, refusals never silent defaults, one shared JDN, rational {num, den} so callers round once). ACT_ACT_ICMA is derived from ICMA Primary Market Handbook Appendix A5 - Rule 251 day count fraction (https://www.icmagroup.org/assets/documents/ICMA-PMH-Appendix-A5-March-2022.pdf), snapshot at research/clause-snapshots/icma-pmh-appendix-a5-day-count-fraction-2022-03.pdf (sha256:df202577082b6d3a4c0ffb83ce7e6c62da4fefce71d1993191f1cb86a11ba256), retrieved 2026-10-20. ISDA 4.16/4.12 formulas use the same pinned 2006 ISDA Definitions snapshot as art-626 (sha256:d58d3558747aaba8e5207417482dd2a35ef11b2fadc9e07d8546c71a2bee8b59). Golden fixtures are hand-verified arithmetic solved forward from the clause formulas (v1 29/360, v2 182/360 vs v3 181/360, v4 180/360 vs v5 179/360, v6 182/360, v7 366/365, v8 184/365+182/366, v9 29/366, v10 92/(183x2), v14 2/252), output_payload generated by this kernel's own compute(); no QuantLib or other oracle binary is shipped.
input_schema_provenance: Each property is exactly the policy_parameters member the kernel reads; there is no other input surface. mode/start/end are required; every other property is mode-scoped and optional, and each carries the validation the kernel enforces (closed mode enum, real calendar dates, ordered pair, declared ICMA schedule bound of 1200 periods, declared frequency set, calendar bounds of 5000 holidays and weekday integers 0-6).
author: PostOakLabs

output_example.note: fraction is the exact gcd-reduced integer rational {num, den}; fraction_value is the declared single-division float convenience form. Round once, after multiplying.
